info.title: National Auto Spares — Billing & Inventory API

post.description:
Rotates the token. Presenting a consumed one revokes the whole family
(FR-AUTH-002) — a consumed token in the wild means the cookie was copied.

get.description: The caller's own context. Needs no specific permission.

post.description:
Reachable while `must_change_password` is set — it is the one thing such a user
must be able to do.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get
Response List Devices Api V1 Admin Devices Get

post.description:
Stops refresh immediately and refuses sync on every endpoint (T-4).

Local data on the device is **never** deleted in response — the client shows a
blocking screen. Unsynced drafts are lost by design; they were never sales (E-11).

schema.title: Response List Settings Api V1 Admin Settings Get

put.description:
Audited with before/after values (FR-AUDIT-003).

A discount cap or a credit term is a business rule that moves money, so "who
changed this and when" has to be answerable.

get.description:
Minimum query length **1**. Results are ranked exact SKU → SKU prefix → name
prefix → alias → trigram, with sales frequency then name as the tie-break.

schema.title: Response Search Products Api V1 Products Search Get
Response Lookup Barcode Api V1 Products Lookup Barcode Get
Response Get Product Api V1 Products  Product Id  Get

patch.description: A price change is audited with before/after values (FR-AUDIT-003, T-2).

schema.title: Response Update Product Api V1 Products  Product Id  Patch
Response Create Product Api V1 Products Post

post.description: Never deletes (FR-CAT-009).

Adding an alias refreshes the parent's `search_text` (fix S-8), otherwise the
alias is stored but unsearchable.

schema.title: Response Add Alias Api V1 Products  Product Id  Aliases Post
Response List Aliases Api V1 Products  Product Id  Aliases Get
Response List Units Api V1 Units Get

post.description:
Seed the default units for a business created after migration 0016 ran.

Units are reference data a spare-parts shop cannot operate without. A tax rate, a
product or a business identity is **never** seeded.

schema.title: Response Ensure Default Units Api V1 Units Ensure Defaults Post
Response List Brands Api V1 Brands Get
Response List Categories Api V1 Categories Get
Response List Balances Api V1 Inventory Balances Get

get.description: The append-only ledger (FR-INV-001).

schema.title: Response List Movements Api V1 Inventory Movements Get

post.description:
A reasoned, audited correction. `Idempotency-Key` is required so a retried
adjustment cannot be applied twice.

schema.title: Response Create Adjustment Api V1 Inventory Adjustments Post

get.description:
Read-only. **Reports and never repairs** (FR-INV-006).

Also carries T3-04's numbering check: per series, `max(sequence_number) + 1` must
equal `next_number`. A mismatch indicates a lost update and is reported, not
corrected.

schema.title: Response Latest Reconciliation Api V1 Inventory Reconciliation Latest Get

post.description:
Runs the check now rather than waiting for the nightly job.

Still read-only with respect to balances — it writes only its own report row.

schema.title: Response Run Reconciliation Api V1 Inventory Reconciliation Run Post

get.description: Matches name, phone, business name and vehicle.

schema.title: Response Search Customers Api V1 Customers Search Get
Response Get Customer Api V1 Customers  Customer Id  Get

put.description:
Needs no `Idempotency-Key` — the client-generated id makes it naturally
idempotent (`API-SPECIFICATION.md §5`).

schema.title: Response Upsert Customer Api V1 Customers  Customer Id  Put

post.description: Surfaces candidates for a person to choose between. **Never merges.**

schema.title: Response Check Duplicates Api V1 Customers Check Duplicates Post

get.description: Invoices, payments and credit notes with a running balance.

schema.title: Response Customer Ledger Api V1 Customers  Customer Id  Ledger Get

post.description: Soft deactivate. A referenced customer is never hard-deleted.

schema.title: Response List Drafts Api V1 Drafts Get
Response Get Draft Api V1 Drafts  Draft Id  Get

put.description:
Saving a draft **never** finalises a sale and **never** deducts stock
(FR-DRAFT-005).

schema.title: Response Upsert Draft Api V1 Drafts  Draft Id  Put

delete.description:
`Clear Draft`. Marks `cancelled`, audited, **never** hard-deletes and never
removes a finalised sale.

schema.title: Response Takeover Draft Api V1 Drafts  Draft Id  Takeover Post

post.description:
Atomically finalise a cash or credit sale.

Everything between BEGIN and COMMIT either all happens or none of it does
(FR-SALE-001): the invoice, its item snapshots, the stock movements, any payment, the
draft's finalised state, the audit row and the outbox event. Stock is deducted
**exactly once**.

schema.title: Response Finalize Sale Api V1 Sales Finalize Post

post.description:
Writes payment and allocation rows **only**.

`Idempotency-Key` is required (FR-PAY-004), so a retried submission records one
payment rather than two.

schema.title: Response Record Payment Api V1 Payments Post
Response List Payments Api V1 Payments Get

post.description: Creates a reversal row. The original is **never** edited (FR-PAY-005).

schema.title: Response Reverse Payment Api V1 Payments  Payment Id  Reverse Post

get.description: Derived from authoritative data (FR-CREDIT-002), never from a cache table.

schema.title: Response Credit Outstanding Api V1 Credit Outstanding Get
Response Ageing Summary Api V1 Credit Ageing Summary Get

get.description:
The top level of the Credit Bills view (FR-CREDIT-011, FR-RPT-028).

Every aggregate is **server-computed** — the client never sums these as
authoritative (FR-RPT-030, ADR-032). Grouping keys on `customer_id`, so a rename
changes only the label (FR-RPT-029).

schema.title: Response Credit Customers Api V1 Credit Customers Get

post.description: Owner-only. Produces a credit note carrying the reason.

schema.title: Response Write Off Api V1 Credit Write Off Post
Response Allocate Credit Note Api V1 Credit Notes  Note Id  Allocations Post

get.description: Backs Daily Bills **and** Credit Bills — one dataset, two views (FR-RPT-003).

schema.title: Response List Invoices Api V1 Invoices Get
Response Get Invoice Api V1 Invoices  Invoice Id  Get

get.description:
Everything needed to render the document (FR-PRINT-001).

**A plain read.** It never calls a finalisation endpoint and creates nothing — no
sale, no number, no movement.

schema.title: Response Get Print Payload Api V1 Invoices  Invoice Id  Print Payload Get

post.description:
Records a print attempt (FR-PRINT-004).

A logging failure **never blocks printing**: a customer waiting for their bill is
not a good moment to fail on an audit nicety, so the error is logged server-side and
the route still succeeds.

Reverses stock exactly, issues a full-value credit note for a credit sale,
**retains** the internal reference and keeps the record listed.

schema.title: Response Cancel Invoice Api V1 Invoices  Invoice Id  Cancel Post

get.description:
Counts, gross, discount, tax, net, and a breakdown by payment method.

**Credit sales are included**, on their sale date (FR-RPT-001) — a credit sale is a
sale, and excluding it would understate the day's trading.

schema.title: Response Daily Sales Api V1 Reports Daily Sales Get

get.description:
The other view of the same dataset as `daily-sales`. The two must reconcile
exactly (FR-RPT-003).

schema.title: Response Credit Outstanding Report Api V1 Reports Credit Outstanding Get

get.description:
Proves daily sales and credit outstanding describe the same money.

A `reconciles: false` means `amount_paid` has drifted from the allocations, which is
NFR-DATA-003 failing — it is reported, never auto-corrected.

schema.title: Response Reconciliation Check Api V1 Reports Reconciliation Check Get
Response Stock Position Api V1 Reports Stock Position Get

get.description:
Margin requires `catalog.cost.read` on top of this report's permission; the
columns are **omitted** rather than nulled when it is absent.

schema.title: Response Item Sales Api V1 Reports Item Sales Get

get.description: Cash expected versus collected, per counter per day.

schema.title: Response Counter Reconciliation Api V1 Reports Counter Reconciliation Get

get.description:
Streaming CSV (FR-RPT-007).

Leading `=`, `+`, `-` and `@` are escaped, so a product named `=cmd()` arrives in
the accountant's spreadsheet as text rather than a formula.

post.description:
Apply a bounded batch of safe offline operations.

A bad operation never blocks the rest of the batch, except that operations for the
**same entity** stop at the first failure to preserve ordering — a later edit
applied before an unresolved earlier one would silently reorder the user's work.

schema.title: Response Apply Operations Api V1 Sync Operations Post

get.description:
A bounded delta for the offline cache.

**`cost_price` is never included, regardless of permission** — a stolen counter
machine must not carry the shop's margins (`SECURITY.md §11`).

schema.title: Response Catalog Delta Api V1 Sync Catalog Get

get.description:
One call after login.

Publishes the **money policy** so the client never hardcodes a rounding rule, the
client-visible settings, the print profile and the date order — and states plainly
that offline finalisation is refused, so the client can show the reason rather than
inventing one.

schema.title: Response Bootstrap Api V1 Sync Bootstrap Get

get.description: The registry, so a client can verify it rather than assume it.

schema.title: Response Operation Types Api V1 Sync Operation Types Get
Response List Suppliers Api V1 Suppliers Get
Response Upsert Supplier Api V1 Suppliers  Supplier Id  Put

post.description:
Creates a `draft`. **No stock change** — recording a supplier's delivery note is
not the same as the goods being on the shelf.

schema.title: Response Create Purchase Api V1 Purchases Post
Response List Purchases Api V1 Purchases Get

post.description: **The only path that receives stock** (FR-PUR-003). Idempotent.

schema.title: Response Confirm Purchase Api V1 Purchases  Purchase Id  Confirm Post

post.description:
Only while `draft`. A confirmed receipt is immutable — correcting it is a
supplier return or an adjustment, not an edit.

Credits the **snapshot price** — what the customer paid, not today's price.

Damaged goods, or an explicit `restock: false`, become **scrap** rather than
sellable stock.

schema.title: Response Create Return Api V1 Returns Post
Response List Returns Api V1 Returns Get

get.description:
Authenticated, but needs no specific permission: it reports the server's own
version and time to whoever is signed in.

CatalogDeltaOut.title: CatalogDeltaOut
CatalogDeltaOut.description:
⚠️ `cost_price` is **never** present, regardless of permission: a stolen counter
machine must not carry the shop's margins (`SECURITY.md §11`).

CreditCustomerOut-Input.title: CreditCustomerOut
CreditCustomerOut-Input.description:
Every aggregate is **server-computed**; the client never sums these
(FR-RPT-030, ADR-032).

CreditCustomerOut-Output.title: CreditCustomerOut
CreditCustomerOut-Output.description:
Every aggregate is **server-computed**; the client never sums these
(FR-RPT-030, ADR-032).

DailySalesOut.title: DailySalesOut
DailySalesOut.description: `GET /reports/daily-sales` — the one report a screen renders field by field.

DraftPreviewTotalsOut-Input.title: DraftPreviewTotalsOut
DraftPreviewTotalsOut-Input.description:
Always advisory. The server recomputes everything at finalisation
(FR-DRAFT-011).

DraftPreviewTotalsOut-Output.title: DraftPreviewTotalsOut
DraftPreviewTotalsOut-Output.description:
Always advisory. The server recomputes everything at finalisation
(FR-DRAFT-011).

FinalizeOut.title: FinalizeOut
FinalizeOut.description: The `201` from `POST /sales:finalize` — cash and credit alike (ADR-033).

InvoiceOut.title: InvoiceOut
InvoiceOut.description:
One shape, returned by `POST /sales:finalize` **and** `GET /invoices/{id}`.

Built by a single serialiser (`api/v1/serialize.py`), because the confirmation card
and the Daily Bills detail describe the same bill.

MoneyPolicyOut.title: MoneyPolicyOut
MoneyPolicyOut.description: Published so the client never hardcodes a rounding or whole-rupee rule.

PrintBusinessOut.title: PrintBusinessOut
PrintBusinessOut.description: Empty optional fields print nothing — **never a placeholder** (FR-PRINT-016).

PrintPayloadOut.title: PrintPayloadOut
PrintPayloadOut.description:
⚠️ Carries **no invoice number** of any kind (OD-3, T3-06).

`document_title` comes from the server only and is `ESTIMATE` for cash and credit
alike until the FR-TAX-003 gate passes (OD-24, FR-PRINT-021).

ReportOut.title: ReportOut
ReportOut.description:
The common report envelope (`API-SPECIFICATION.md §3.11`).

⚠️ The **only** permissive model in this module. Each report spreads its own figures
at the top level — `daily-sales` has `gross`/`net`/`by_day`, `stock-position` has
`rows` — so `extra="forbid"` would make one model impossible. The envelope is what
every report shares and what the client relies on; the per-report figures are typed
where a screen renders them field by field (`DailySalesOut`).

SaleHeaderIn.title: SaleHeaderIn
SaleHeaderIn.description: Optional for **both** sale types, and persisted when present (FR-CREDIT-012).
